title.en: An Act to Authorize the Secretary of Public Instruction to Make An Allotment From the Amount Appropriated in Act Numbered Two thousand and Twenty-Nine for the Construction of a School on Land Belonging to the Government of the United states in the Naval Reservation At Olongapo.

text.en:
The Secretary of Public Instruction is hereby authorized to allot from the amount appropriated
by Act Numbered Two thousand and twenty-nine a sum to be used for the purpose of constructing a public
school on land the property of the Government of the United States in the naval reservation at Olongapo, the
provisions of subsection (c) of section one of Act Numbered Two thousand and twenty-nine to the contrary
notwithstanding.

The expenditure of any sum allotted under the preceding section shall in all other respects be
governed by the provisions prescribed in Act Numbered Two thousand and twenty-nine aforesaid.

This Act shall take effect upon its passage.
Enacted, December 6, 1912.
